_note: Produces the Story Stage image used by the root README and the docs site. Story Stage is a view of a running session, not a scene that can stage itself: it shows whoever is speaking in the story log, so the run opens a Story Catalyst session, takes one real turn against Ireti Okan, then mounts the stage beside it to replay that log with backdrop, portrait and speech. That costs a model call and a few minutes, so it is run deliberately rather than as part of a suite - see the capture guide. Two preconditions are the operator's: a model provider must be configured, and the Story Stage character art must be installed, since it ships as an optional content pack. The stage displays one entry at a time and fades the portrait between them, so the run captures a series and the best frame is published; the AI character arrives third, after the narrator's welcome and the typed line have each been spoken. The window is 16:9 rather than the 1600x1120 the other published captures use, because the stage is laid out for the project's 1152x648 viewport: any other ratio expands the canvas, which drifts the centre-anchored input field over the portrait and pushes a long line past the fold of its dialogue box.
